content: Lakini itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Tiro na Sidoni kustahimili katika siku ya hukumu, kuliko ninyi.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Nawe, Kapernaumu, je, utainuliwa hadi mbinguni? La hasha, utashushwa mpaka kuzimu.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: “Yeye awasikilizaye ninyi anisikiliza mimi; naye awakataaye ninyi amenikataa mimi. Lakini yeye anikataaye mimi amkataa yeye aliyenituma.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Wale sabini na wawili wakarudi kwa furaha, na kusema, “Bwana, hata pepo wachafu wanatutii kwa jina lako.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yesu akawaambia, “Nilimwona Shetani akianguka kutoka mbinguni kama umeme wa radi.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Tazama nimewapa mamlaka ya kukanyaga nyoka na nge na juu ya nguvu zote za adui; wala hakuna kitu chochote kitakachowadhuru.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Basi, msifurahi kwa kuwa pepo wachafu wanawatii, bali furahini kwa kuwa majina yenu yameandikwa mbinguni.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Wakati huo Yesu akashangilia katika Roho Mtakatifu, akasema, “Nakuhimidi Baba, Bwana wa mbingu na nchi, kwa kuwa umewaficha mambo haya wenye hekima na wenye elimu, nawe ukawafunulia watoto wadogo. Naam, Baba, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo ilivyokupendeza.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: “Nimekabidhiwa vitu vyote na Baba yangu. Hakuna mtu amjuaye Mwana ni nani ila Baba, wala hakuna amjuaye Baba ni nani ila Mwana na yeyote ambaye Mwana anapenda kumfunulia.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Basi Yesu akawageukia wanafunzi wake akanena nao faraghani, akawaambia, “Heri macho yanayoona yale mambo mnayoyaona.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Kwa maana nawaambia, manabii wengi na wafalme walitamani kuona yale mnayoyaona lakini hawakuyaona, na walitamani kusikia yale mnayoyasikia lakini hawakuyasikia.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Wakati huo mtaalamu mmoja wa sheria alisimama ili kumjaribu Yesu, akamuuliza, “Mwalimu, nifanye nini ili niurithi uzima wa milele?”

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Yesu akamjibu, “Imeandikwaje katika Sheria? Kwani unasoma nini humo?”

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Akajibu, “ ‘Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, kwa roho yako yote, kwa nguvu zako zote, na kwa akili zako zote’; tena, ‘Mpende jirani yako kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe.’ ”

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Yesu akamwambia, “Umejibu vyema. Fanya hivyo nawe utaishi.”

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Lakini yule mtaalamu wa sheria, akitaka kujionyesha kuwa mwenye haki, akamuuliza Yesu, “Jirani yangu ni nani?”

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Yesu akamjibu akasema, “Mtu mmoja alikuwa akiteremka kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Yeriko, naye akaangukia mikononi mwa wanyangʼanyi. Wakampiga, wakaondoka, wakamwacha akiwa karibu kufa.

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Kuhani mmoja alikuwa akipitia njia ile, alipomwona huyo mtu, akapita upande mwingine, akamwacha hapo barabarani.

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Vivyo hivyo, Mlawi mmoja naye alipofika mahali pale, alimwona, akapita upande mwingine, akamwacha hapo barabarani

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Lakini Msamaria mmoja aliyekuwa akisafiri alipomwona, alimhurumia.

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Akaenda alipokuwa na akasafisha majeraha yake kwa divai na mafuta, kisha akayafunga. Ndipo akampandisha kwenye punda wake, akampeleka mpaka kwenye nyumba ya wageni na kumtunza.

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Kesho yake, yule Msamaria akachukua dinari mbili akampa yule mwenye nyumba ya wageni na kusema, ‘Mtunze, nami nirudipo nitakulipa gharama yoyote ya ziada uliyotumia kwa ajili yake.’

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: “Ni yupi basi miongoni mwa hawa watatu wewe unadhani ni jirani yake yule mtu aliyeangukia mikononi mwa wanyangʼanyi?”

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content:
Yule mtaalamu wa sheria akajibu, “Ni yule aliyemhurumia.”
    Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Nenda, ukafanye vivyo hivyo.”

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Ikawa Yesu na wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakienda Yerusalemu, akaingia kwenye kijiji kimoja ambapo mwanamke mmoja aliyeitwa Martha alimkaribisha nyumbani kwake.

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Martha alikuwa na mdogo wake aliyeitwa Maria, ambaye aliketi chini miguuni mwa Bwana akisikiliza yale aliyokuwa akisema.

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Lakini Martha alikuwa akihangaika na maandalizi yote yaliyokuwa yafanyike. Martha akaja kwa Yesu na kumuuliza, “Bwana, hujali kwamba ndugu yangu ameniachia kazi zote mwenyewe? Basi mwambie anisaidie.”

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Lakini Bwana akamjibu, “Martha, Martha, mbona unasumbuka na kuhangaika na mengi?

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Lakini kunahitajika kitu kimoja tu. Maria amechagua kile kilicho bora, wala hakuna mtu atakayemwondolea.”

teaching.description: MFANO WA MSAMARIA MWEMA
teaching.name: Luka 10:25-42

content: Siku moja, Yesu alikuwa mahali fulani akiomba. Alipomaliza kuomba, mmoja wa wanafunzi wake akamwambia, “Bwana, tufundishe kuomba, kama vile Yohana alivyowafundisha wanafunzi wake.”

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content:
Akawaambia, “Mnapoomba, semeni:
  “ ‘Baba yetu (uliye mbinguni),
  jina lako litukuzwe,
    ufalme wako uje.
  (Mapenzi yako yafanyike
    hapa duniani kama huko mbinguni.)

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Utupatie kila siku riziki yetu.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content:
Utusamehe dhambi zetu,
    kwa kuwa na sisi huwasamehe wote wanaotukosea.
  Wala usitutie majaribuni
    (bali utuokoe kutoka kwa yule mwovu).’ ”

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Kisha akawaambia, “Ni nani miongoni mwenu mwenye rafiki yake, naye akamwendea usiku wa manane na kumwambia, ‘Rafiki, nikopeshe mikate mitatu.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Kwa sababu rafiki yangu amekuja kutoka safarini, nami sina kitu cha kumpa.’

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Kisha yule aliyeko ndani amjibu, ‘Usinisumbue. Mlango umefungwa, nami na watoto wangu tumelala. Siwezi kuamka nikupe chochote.’

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Nawaambia, ingawa huyo mtu hataamka na kumpa hiyo mikate kwa sababu ni rafiki yake, lakini kwa sababu ya kuendelea kwake kuomba, ataamka na kumpa kiasi anachohitaji.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Kwa hiyo nawaambia: Ombeni nanyi mtapewa; tafuteni nanyi mtapata; bisheni nanyi mtafunguliwa mlango.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Kwa kuwa kila aombaye hupewa; naye kila atafutaye hupata; na kila abishaye hufunguliwa mlango.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Je, kuna yeyote miongoni mwenu ambaye mtoto wake akimwomba samaki, atampa nyoka badala yake?

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Au mtoto akimwomba yai atampa nge?

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Basi ikiwa ninyi mlio waovu, mnajua kuwapa watoto wenu vitu vizuri, si zaidi sana Baba yenu aliye mbinguni atawapa Roho Mtakatifu wale wamwombao!”

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Basi Yesu alikuwa anamtoa pepo mchafu kutoka kwa mtu aliyekuwa bubu. Yule pepo mchafu alipomtoka yule mtu aliyekuwa bubu, akaanza kuongea, nao umati wa watu ukashangaa.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Lakini wengine wakasema, “Anatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa Beelzebuli, yule mkuu wa pepo wachafu wote.”

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Wengine ili kumjaribu wakataka awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Yesu akajua mawazo yao, naye akawaambia, “Kila ufalme ukigawanyika dhidi yake wenyewe huangamia. Nayo nyumba iliyogawanyika dhidi yake yenyewe itaanguka.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Kama Shetani amegawanyika mwenyewe, ufalme wake utasimamaje? Nawaambia haya kwa sababu ninyi mnadai ya kuwa mimi ninatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa Beelzebuli.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Kama mimi natoa pepo wachafu kwa nguvu za Beelzebuli, wafuasi wenu nao je, wao hutoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa nani? Hivyo basi, wao ndio watakaowahukumu.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Lakini kama mimi ninatoa pepo wachafu kwa kidole cha Mungu, basi Ufalme wa Mungu umewajia.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Mtu mwenye nguvu aliyejifunga silaha anapoilinda nyumba yake, mali yake iko salama.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Lakini mtu mwenye nguvu zaidi kumliko akimshambulia na kumshinda, yeye humnyangʼanya silaha zake zote alizozitegemea, na kuchukua nyara.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Mtu asiyekuwa pamoja nami yu kinyume nami, na mtu ambaye hakusanyi pamoja nami, hutawanya.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Pepo mchafu amtokapo mtu, hutangatanga katika sehemu zisizo na maji akitafuta mahali pa kupumzika, lakini hapati. Ndipo husema, ‘Nitarudi kwenye nyumba yangu nilikotoka.’

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Naye arudipo na kuikuta ile nyumba imefagiliwa na kupangwa vizuri,

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: ndipo huenda na kuchukua pepo wachafu wengine saba wabaya kuliko yeye mwenyewe, nao huingia na kukaa humo. Nayo hali ya mwisho ya yule mtu huwa ni mbaya kuliko ile ya kwanza.”

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Ikawa Yesu alipokuwa akisema hayo, mwanamke mmoja katikati ya ule umati wa watu akapaza sauti akasema, “Limebarikiwa tumbo lililokuzaa na matiti uliyonyonya!”

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Yesu akajibu, “Wamebarikiwa zaidi wale wanaolisikia neno la Mungu na kulitii.”

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Umati wa watu ulipokuwa unazidi kuongezeka, Yesu akaendelea kusema, “Hiki ni kizazi kiovu. Kinatafuta ishara, lakini hakitapewa ishara yoyote isipokuwa ile ya Yona.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Kwa maana kama vile Yona alivyokuwa ishara kwa watu wa Ninawi, ndivyo Mwana wa Adamu atakavyokuwa ishara kwa kizazi hiki.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Malkia wa Kusini atasimama wakati wa hukumu na kuwahukumu watu wa kizazi hiki. Kwa kuwa yeye alikuja kutoka miisho ya dunia ili kuisikiliza hekima ya Solomoni. Na hapa yupo aliye mkuu kuliko Solomoni.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Siku ya hukumu, watu wa Ninawi watasimama pamoja na kizazi hiki na kukihukumu; kwa maana wao walitubu waliposikia mahubiri ya Yona. Na tazama, hapa yupo yeye aliye mkuu kuliko Yona.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Hakuna mtu yeyote awashaye taa na kuiweka mahali palipofichika au kuifunikia chini ya bakuli. Badala yake huiweka juu ya kinara chake, ili watu wote wanaoingia waone nuru.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Jicho lako ni taa ya mwili wako. Kama jicho lako ni zima, mwili wako wote pia umejaa nuru. Lakini kama jicho ni bovu, mwili wako wote pia umejaa giza.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Kwa hiyo, hakikisha kwamba nuru iliyoko ndani yako isiwe giza.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Basi ikiwa mwili wako wote umejaa nuru, bila sehemu yake yoyote kuwa gizani, basi utakuwa na nuru kama vile taa ikuangazavyo kwa nuru yake.”

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Yesu alipomaliza kuzungumza, Farisayo mmoja alimwalika nyumbani mwake kwa chakula. Yesu akaingia na kuketi katika sehemu yake mezani.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Yule Farisayo akashangaa kwamba Yesu hakunawa kwanza kabla ya kula.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia, “Sasa, enyi Mafarisayo, mnasafisha kikombe na sahani kwa nje, lakini ndani mmejaa unyangʼanyi na uovu.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Enyi wapumbavu! Hamjui kuwa yeye aliyetengeneza nje ndiye alitengeneza na ndani pia?

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Basi toeni sadaka ya vile mlivyo navyo, na tazama, vitu vyote vitakuwa safi kwenu.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Lakini ole wenu, Mafarisayo, kwa maana mnampa Mungu zaka za mnanaa, mchicha na kila aina ya mboga, lakini mnapuuza haki na upendo wa Mungu. Iliwapasa kufanya haya ya pili bila kupuuza hayo ya kwanza.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Ole wenu Mafarisayo, kwa sababu ninyi mnapenda kukalia viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kusalimiwa kwa heshima masokoni.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Ole wenu, kwa sababu ninyi ni kama makaburi yasiyokuwa na alama, ambayo watu huyakanyaga pasipo kujua.”

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Mtaalamu mmoja wa sheria akamjibu, akasema, “Mwalimu, unaposema mambo haya, unatutukana na sisi pia.”

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Yesu akamjibu, “Nanyi wataalamu wa sheria, ole wenu, kwa sababu mnawatwika watu mizigo mizito ambayo hawawezi kubeba, wala ninyi wenyewe hamwinui hata kidole kimoja kuwasaidia.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Ole wenu, kwa sababu ninyi mnajenga makaburi ya manabii waliouawa na baba zenu.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Hivyo ninyi mwashuhudia na mnathibitisha kile baba zenu walichofanya. Wao waliwaua manabii, nanyi mnawajengea makaburi.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Kwa sababu ya jambo hili, Mungu katika hekima yake alisema, ‘Tazama, nitatuma kwao manabii na mitume, nao watawaua baadhi yao na wengine watawatesa.’

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Kwa hiyo kizazi hiki kitawajibika kwa ajili ya damu ya manabii iliyomwagwa tangu kuwekwa misingi ya ulimwengu,

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: tangu damu ya Abeli mpaka damu ya Zekaria, aliyeuawa kati ya madhabahu na mahali patakatifu. Naam, nawaambia, kizazi hiki kitawajibika kwa haya yote.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: “Ole wenu ninyi wataalamu wa sheria, kwa sababu mmeuondoa ufunguo wa maarifa. Ninyi wenyewe hamkuingia, na wale waliokuwa wanaingia mkawazuia.”

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Yesu alipoondoka huko, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo wakaanza kumpinga vikali na kumsonga kwa maswali,

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: wakivizia kumkamata kwa kitu atakachosema ili wamshtaki.

teaching.description: Yesu ATUMIA MIFANO KUWAFUNDISHA WANAFUNZI JINSI YA KUOMBA - RAFIKI ASIYECHOKA KUOMBA
teaching.name: Luka 11

content: Wakati huo, umati mkubwa wa watu maelfu, walipokuwa wamekusanyika hata wakawa wanakanyagana, Yesu akaanza kuzungumza kwanza na wanafunzi wake, akawaambia: “Jihadharini na chachu ya Mafarisayo, yaani, unafiki wao.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Hakuna jambo lolote lililositirika ambalo halitafunuliwa, au lililofichwa ambalo halitajulikana.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Kwa hiyo, lolote mlilosema gizani litasikiwa nuruni. Na kile mlichonongʼona masikioni mkiwa kwenye vyumba vya ndani, kitatangazwa juu ya paa.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Nawaambieni rafiki zangu, msiwaogope wale wauao mwili, lakini baada ya hilo hawawezi kufanya lolote zaidi.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Lakini nitawaambia nani wa kumwogopa: Mwogopeni yule ambaye baada ya kuua mwili, ana mamlaka ya kuwatupa motoni. Naam, nawaambia, mwogopeni huyo!

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Mnajua kwamba shomoro watano huuzwa kwa senti mbili? Lakini Mungu hamsahau hata mmoja wao.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Naam, hata nywele za vichwa vyenu zote zimehesabiwa. Hivyo msiogope, kwa maana ninyi ni wa thamani kubwa kuliko shomoro wengi.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Ninawaambia kwamba yeyote atakayenikiri mbele ya watu, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamkiri mbele za malaika wa Mungu.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Lakini yeye atakayenikana mimi mbele ya watu, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamkana mbele ya malaika wa Mungu.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Naye kila atakayenena neno baya dhidi ya Mwana wa Adamu atasamehewa, lakini yeyote atakayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Watakapowapeleka katika masinagogi, na mbele ya watawala na wenye mamlaka, msiwe na wasiwasi kuhusu namna mtakavyojitetea au mtakavyosema.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Kwa maana Roho Mtakatifu atawafundisha wakati huo huo mnachopaswa kusema.”

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Mtu mmoja katika umati wa watu akamwambia Yesu, “Mwalimu, mwambie ndugu yangu tugawane naye urithi wetu.”

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, “Rafiki, ni nani aliyeniweka mimi kuwa hakimu wenu au msuluhishi juu yenu?”

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Jihadharini! Jilindeni na aina zote za choyo. Kwa maana maisha ya mtu hayatokani na wingi wa mali alizo nazo.”

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Kisha akawaambia mfano huu: “Shamba la mtu mmoja tajiri lilizaa sana.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Akawaza moyoni mwake, ‘Nifanye nini? Sina mahali pa kuhifadhi mavuno yangu.’

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Ndipo huyo tajiri akasema, ‘Nitafanya hivi: Nitabomoa ghala zangu za nafaka na kujenga nyingine kubwa zaidi na huko nitayahifadhi mavuno yangu yote na vitu vyangu.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Nami nitaiambia nafsi yangu, “Nafsi, unavyo vitu vingi vizuri ulivyojiwekea akiba kwa miaka mingi. Pumzika; kula, unywe, ufurahi.” ’

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Lakini Mungu akamwambia, ‘Mpumbavu wewe! Usiku huu uhai wako unatakiwa. Sasa hivyo vitu ulivyojiwekea akiba vitakuwa vya nani?’

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Hivyo ndivyo ilivyo kwa wale wanaojiwekea mali lakini hawajitajirishi kwa Mungu.”

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake: “Kwa hiyo nawaambia, msisumbukie maisha yenu kwamba mtakula nini; au msumbukie miili yenu kwamba mtavaa nini.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Maisha ni zaidi ya chakula, na mwili ni zaidi ya mavazi.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Fikirini ndege! Wao hawapandi wala hawavuni, hawana ghala wala popote pa kuhifadhi nafaka; lakini Mungu huwalisha. Ninyi ni wa thamani zaidi kuliko ndege!

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Ni nani miongoni mwenu ambaye kwa kujitaabisha kwake anaweza kujiongezea hata saa moja zaidi katika maisha yake?

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Kama hamwezi kufanya jambo dogo kama hilo, kwa nini basi kuyasumbukia hayo mengine?

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Angalieni maua jinsi yameavyo: Hayafanyi kazi wala hayafumi. Lakini nawaambia, hata Solomoni katika fahari yake yote hakuvikwa vizuri kama mojawapo ya hayo maua.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Basi ikiwa Mungu huyavika hivi majani ya shambani, ambayo leo yapo, na kesho yanatupwa motoni, si atawavika ninyi vizuri zaidi, enyi wa imani haba!

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Wala msisumbuke mioyoni mwenu mtakula nini au mtakunywa nini. Msiwe na wasiwasi juu ya haya.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Watu wa mataifa ya duniani husumbuka sana kuhusu vitu hivi vyote, lakini Baba yenu anafahamu kuwa mnahitaji haya yote.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Bali utafuteni Ufalme wa Mungu, na haya yote atawapa pia.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Msiogope enyi kundi dogo, kwa maana Baba yenu ameona vyema kuwapa ninyi Ufalme.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Uzeni mali zenu mkawape maskini. Jifanyieni mifuko isiyochakaa, mkajiwekee hazina mbinguni isiyokwisha, mahali ambapo mwizi hakaribii wala nondo haharibu.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Kwa sababu mahali hazina yako ilipo, hapo ndipo moyo wako utakapokuwa pia.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Kuweni tayari mkiwa mmevikwa kwa ajili ya huduma na taa zenu zikiwa zinawaka,

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: kama watumishi wanaomngojea bwana wao arudi kutoka kwenye karamu ya arusi, ili ajapo na kubisha mlango waweze kumfungulia mara.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Heri wale watumishi ambao bwana wao atakapokuja atawakuta wakiwa wanakesha. Amin, nawaambia, atajifunga mkanda wake na kuwaketisha ili wale, naye atakuja na kuwahudumia.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Itakuwa heri kwa watumwa hao ikiwa bwana wao atakapokuja atawakuta wamekesha hata kama atakuja mnamo usiku wa manane, au karibu na mapambazuko.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Lakini fahamuni jambo hili: Kama mwenye nyumba angalijua saa mwizi atakuja, asingaliiacha nyumba yake kuvunjwa.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Ninyi nanyi hamna budi kuwa tayari, kwa sababu Mwana wa Adamu atakuja saa msiyotazamia.”

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Ndipo Petro akamuuliza, “Bwana, mfano huu unatuambia sisi peke yetu au watu wote?”

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Yesu akamjibu, “Ni yupi basi wakili mwaminifu na mwenye busara, ambaye bwana wake atamfanya msimamizi juu ya watumishi wake wote, ili awape watumishi wengine chakula chao wakati unaofaa?

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Heri mtumishi yule ambaye bwana wake atakaporudi atamkuta akifanya hivyo.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Amin nawaambia, atamweka mtumishi huyo kuwa msimamizi wa mali yake yote.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Lakini kama yule mtumishi atasema moyoni mwake, ‘Bwana wangu anakawia kurudi,’ kisha akaanza kuwapiga wale watumishi wa kiume na wa kike, na kula na kunywa na kulewa.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Basi bwana wa mtumishi huyo atakuja siku asiyodhani na saa asiyoijua. Atamkata vipande vipande na kumweka katika sehemu moja pamoja na wale wasioamini.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Yule mtumishi anayefahamu vyema mapenzi ya bwana wake na asijiandae wala kufanya kama apendavyo bwana wake, atapigwa kwa mapigo mengi.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Lakini yeyote ambaye hakujua naye akafanya yale yastahiliyo kupigwa, atapigwa kidogo. Yeyote aliyepewa vitu vingi, atadaiwa vingi; na yeyote aliyekabidhiwa vingi, kwake vitatakiwa vingi.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Nimekuja kuleta moto duniani; laiti kama ungekuwa tayari umewashwa!

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Lakini ninao ubatizo ambao lazima nibatizwe, nayo dhiki yangu ni kuu mpaka ubatizo huo ukamilike!

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Mnadhani nimekuja kuleta amani duniani? La, nawaambia sivyo, nimekuja kuleta mafarakano.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Kuanzia sasa, kutakuwa na watu watano katika nyumba moja, watatu dhidi ya wawili, na wawili dhidi ya watatu.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Watafarakana baba dhidi ya mwanawe na mwana dhidi ya babaye, mama dhidi ya bintiye na binti dhidi ya mamaye, naye mama mkwe dhidi ya mkwewe na mkwe dhidi ya mama mkwe wake.”

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Pia Yesu akauambia ule umati wa watu, “Mwonapo wingu likitokea magharibi, mara mwasema, ‘Mvua itanyesha,’ nayo hunyesha.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Nanyi mwonapo upepo wa kusini ukivuma, ninyi husema, ‘Kutakuwa na joto,’ na huwa hivyo.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Enyi wanafiki! Mnajua jinsi ya kutambua kuonekana kwa dunia na anga. Inakuwaje basi kwamba mnashindwa kutambua wakati huu wa sasa?

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: “Kwa nini hamwamui wenyewe lililo haki?

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Uwapo njiani na mshtaki wako kwenda kwa hakimu, jitahidi kupatana naye mkiwa njiani. La sivyo, atakupeleka kwa hakimu, naye hakimu atakukabidhi kwa afisa, naye afisa atakutupa gerezani.

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Nakuambia, hautatoka humo hadi uwe umelipa senti ya mwisho.”

teaching.description: ONYO DHIDI YA CHACHU YA MAFARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 12

content: Wakati huo huo, kulikuwa na watu waliomwambia Yesu habari za Wagalilaya ambao Pilato aliwaua, na damu ya hao watu akaichanganya na dhabihu yao waliyokuwa wanatoa.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Yesu akawauliza, “Mnadhani kwamba hawa Wagalilaya ambao walikufa kifo cha namna hiyo walikuwa na dhambi kuwazidi Wagalilaya wengine wote?

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: La hasha! Ninyi nanyi msipotubu, mtaangamia vivyo hivyo.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Au wale watu kumi na wanane waliokufa walipoangukiwa na mnara huko Siloamu: mnadhani wao walikuwa waovu kuliko watu wote waliokuwa wanaishi Yerusalemu?

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Nawaambia, la hasha! Ninyi nanyi msipotubu, wote mtaangamia vivyo hivyo.”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Kisha Yesu akawaambia mfano huu: “Mtu mmoja alikuwa na mtini uliopandwa katika shamba lake la mizabibu, akaja ili kutafuta tini kwenye mti huo, lakini hakupata hata moja.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Hivyo akamwambia mtunza shamba: ‘Tazama, kwa muda wa miaka mitatu sasa nimekuwa nikija kutafuta matunda kwenye mtini huu, nami sikupata hata moja. Ukate! Kwa nini uendelee kuharibu ardhi?’

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: “Yule mtunza shamba akamjibu, ‘Bwana, uache tena kwa mwaka mmoja zaidi, nami nitaupalilia na kuuwekea mbolea.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Kama ukizaa matunda mwaka ujao, vyema, la sivyo uukate.’ ”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Basi Yesu alikuwa akifundisha katika sinagogi mojawapo siku ya Sabato.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Wakati huo huo akaja mwanamke mmoja aliyekuwa na pepo mchafu, naye alikuwa amepinda mgongo kwa muda wa miaka kumi na minane, wala alikuwa hawezi kunyooka wima.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Yesu alipomwona, akamwita, akamwambia, “Mwanamke, uwe huru, umepona ugonjwa wako.”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Yesu alipomwekea mikono yake, mara akasimama wima akaanza kumtukuza Mungu.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Lakini kiongozi wa sinagogi akakasirika kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa ameponya mtu siku ya Sabato. Akaambia ule umati wa watu, “Kuna siku sita ambazo watu wanapaswa kufanya kazi. Katika siku hizo, njooni mponywe, lakini si katika siku ya Sabato.”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Lakini Bwana akamjibu, “Enyi wanafiki! Je, kila mmoja wenu hamfungulii ngʼombe wake au punda wake kutoka zizini akampeleka kumnywesha maji siku ya Sabato?

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Je, huyu mwanamke, ambaye ni binti wa Abrahamu, aliyeteswa na Shetani akiwa amemfunga kwa miaka yote hii kumi na minane, hakustahili kufunguliwa kutoka kifungo hicho siku ya Sabato?”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Aliposema haya, wapinzani wake wakaaibika, lakini watu wakafurahi kwa ajili ya mambo ya ajabu aliyoyafanya.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Kisha Yesu akauliza, “Ufalme wa Mungu unafanana na nini? Nitaufananisha na nini?

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Umefanana na punje ya haradali ambayo mtu aliichukua na kuipanda katika shamba lake. Nayo ikakua, ikawa mti nao ndege wa angani wakatengeneza viota vyao kwenye matawi yake.”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Yesu akauliza tena, “Nitaufananisha Ufalme wa Mungu na nini?

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Unafanana na chachu ambayo mwanamke aliichukua akaichanganya katika kiasi kikubwa cha unga mpaka wote ukaumuka.”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Yesu akapita katika miji na vijiji, akifundisha wakati alisafiri kwenda Yerusalemu.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Mtu mmoja akamuuliza, “Bwana, ni watu wachache tu watakaookolewa?”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Yesu akawaambia, “Jitahidini sana kuingia kupitia mlango mwembamba, kwa maana nawaambia wengi watajaribu kuingia, lakini hawataweza.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content:
Wakati mwenye nyumba atakapoondoka na kufunga mlango, mtasimama nje mkibisha mlango na kusema, ‘Bwana! Tufungulie mlango!’
    “Lakini yeye atawajibu, ‘Siwajui ninyi, wala mtokako.’

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: “Ndipo mtamjibu, ‘Tulikula na kunywa pamoja nawe, tena ulifundisha katika mitaa yetu.’

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: “Lakini yeye atawajibu, ‘Siwajui ninyi, wala mtokako. Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi watenda maovu!’

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: “Ndipo kutakuwako kilio na kusaga meno, mtakapowaona Abrahamu, Isaki, Yakobo na manabii wote wakiwa katika Ufalme wa Mungu, lakini ninyi mkiwa mmetupwa nje.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Watu watatoka mashariki na magharibi, kaskazini na kusini, nao wataketi kwenye sehemu walizoandaliwa karamuni katika Ufalme wa Mungu.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Tazama, kunao walio wa mwisho watakaokuwa wa kwanza, nao wa kwanza watakaokuwa wa mwisho.”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Wakati huo huo baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakamwendea Yesu na kumwambia, “Ondoka hapa uende mahali pengine kwa maana Herode anataka kukuua.”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Yesu akawajibu, “Nendeni mkamwambie yule mbweha, ‘Ninafukuza pepo wachafu na kuponya wagonjwa leo na kesho, nami siku ya tatu nitaikamilisha kazi yangu.’

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Sina budi kuendelea na safari yangu leo, kesho na kesho kutwa: kwa maana haiwezekani nabii kufa mahali pengine isipokuwa Yerusalemu.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: “Ee Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, uwauaye manabii na kuwapiga mawe wale waliotumwa kwako! Mara ngapi nimetamani kuwakusanya watoto wako pamoja, kama vile kuku akusanyavyo vifaranga wake chini ya mabawa yake, lakini hukutaka!

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Tazama nyumba yenu imeachwa ukiwa. Ninawaambia, hamtaniona tena mpaka wakati ule mtakaposema, ‘Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa jina la Bwana.’ ”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Ikawa siku moja Yesu alipokuwa amekwenda kula chakula kwa mmoja wa viongozi wa Mafarisayo siku ya Sabato, watu walikuwa wakimchunguza kwa bidii.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Papo hapo mbele yake palikuwa na mtu mmoja mwenye ugonjwa wa kuvimba mwili.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Yesu akawauliza wale Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria, “Je, ni halali kuponya watu siku ya Sabato au la?”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Wakakaa kimya. Hivyo Yesu akamshika yule mgonjwa mkono na kumponya, akamruhusu aende zake.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Kisha akawauliza, “Kama mmoja wenu angekuwa na mtoto au ngʼombe wake aliyetumbukia katika kisima siku ya Sabato, je, hamtamvuta mara moja na kumtoa?”

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Nao hawakuwa na la kusema.

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: Alipoona jinsi wageni walivyokuwa wanachagua mahali pa heshima wakati wa kula, akawaambia mfano huu:

teaching.description: AFUNZA WATU WATUBU NA SI KUHUKUMU WENZAO
teaching.name: Luka 13:1-14:7

content: “Mtu akikualika arusini, usikae mahali pa mgeni wa heshima kwa kuwa inawezekana amealikwa mtu mheshimiwa kuliko wewe.

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Kama mkifanya hivyo yule aliyewaalika ninyi wawili atakuja na kukuambia, ‘Mpishe huyu mtu kiti chako.’ Ndipo kwa aibu utalazimika kukaa katika nafasi ya chini kabisa.

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Badala yake, unapoalikwa, chagua nafasi ya chini, ili yule mwenyeji wako atakapokuona atakuja na kukuambia, ‘Rafiki yangu, nenda kwenye nafasi iliyo bora zaidi.’ Kwa jinsi hii utakuwa umepewa heshima mbele ya wageni wenzako wote.

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Kwa maana kila mtu ajikwezaye atashushwa, naye ajishushaye atakwezwa.”

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Kisha Yesu akamwambia yule aliyewaalika, “Uandaapo karamu ya chakula cha mchana au cha jioni, usialike rafiki zako au ndugu zako au jamaa zako au majirani zako walio matajiri tu. Ukifanya hivyo, wao nao wanaweza kukualika kwao, nawe ukawa umelipwa kile ulichofanya na kupata thawabu yako.

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Bali ufanyapo karamu, waalike maskini, vilema na vipofu,

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: nawe utabarikiwa kwa sababu hawa hawana uwezo wa kukulipa. Mungu atakulipa wakati wa ufufuo wa wenye haki.”

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Mmoja wa wale waliokuwa pamoja naye mezani aliposikia hivi akamwambia Yesu, “Amebarikiwa mtu yule atakayekula katika karamu ya Ufalme wa Mungu!”

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Yesu akamjibu, “Mtu mmoja alikuwa anaandaa karamu kubwa, akaalika watu wengi.

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Wakati wa karamu ulipofika, akamtuma mtumishi wake akawaambie wale walioalikwa, ‘Karibuni, kila kitu ki tayari sasa.’

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: “Lakini wote, kila mmoja, wakaanza kutoa udhuru: Wa kwanza akasema, ‘Nimenunua shamba, lazima niende kuliona. Tafadhali niwie radhi.’

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: “Mwingine akasema, ‘Ndipo tu nimenunua jozi tano za ngʼombe wa kulimia, nami ninakwenda kuwajaribu, tafadhali niwie radhi.’

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Naye mwingine akasema, ‘Nimeoa mke, kwa hiyo siwezi kuja.’

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: “Yule mtumishi akarudi, akampa bwana wake taarifa. Ndipo yule mwenye nyumba akakasirika, akamwagiza yule mtumishi wake, akisema, ‘Nenda upesi kwenye mitaa na vichochoro vya mjini uwalete maskini, vilema, vipofu na viwete.’

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: “Yule mtumishi akamwambia, ‘Bwana, yale uliyoniagiza nimefanya, lakini bado ipo nafasi.’

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: “Ndipo yule bwana akamwambia mtumishi wake, ‘Nenda kwenye barabara na vijia vilivyoko nje ya mji na uwalazimishe watu waingie ili nyumba yangu ipate kujaa.

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Kwa maana nawaambia, hakuna hata mmoja wa wale walioalikwa atakayeionja karamu yangu.’ ”

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulikuwa ukisafiri pamoja na Yesu, naye akageuka, akawaambia,

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: “Mtu yeyote anayekuja kwangu hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wangu kama hatanipenda mimi zaidi ya baba yake na mama yake, mke wake na watoto wake, ndugu zake na dada zake, naam, hata maisha yake mwenyewe.

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Yeyote asiyeuchukua msalaba wake na kunifuata hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wangu.

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: “Ni nani miongoni mwenu ambaye kama anataka kujenga nyumba, hakai kwanza chini na kufanya makisio ya gharama aone kama ana fedha za kutosha kukamilisha?

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: La sivyo, akiisha kuweka msingi, naye akiwa hana uwezo wa kuikamilisha, wote waionao wataanza kumdhihaki,

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: wakisema, ‘Mtu huyu alianza kujenga lakini hakuweza kukamilisha.’

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Kama hawezi, basi wakati yule mwingine akiwa bado yuko mbali, yeye hutuma ujumbe wa watu na kuomba masharti ya amani.

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Vivyo hivyo, yeyote miongoni mwenu ambaye hawezi kuacha vyote alivyo navyo, hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wangu.

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: “Chumvi ni nzuri, lakini chumvi ikiwa imepoteza ladha yake, itafanywaje ili iweze kukolea tena?

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content:
Haifai ardhi wala kwa lundo la mbolea, bali hutupwa nje.
    “Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Basi watoza ushuru na wenye dhambi wote walikuwa wanakusanyika ili wapate kumsikiliza Yesu.

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Lakini Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria wakanungʼunika wakisema, “Huyu mtu anawakaribisha wenye dhambi na kula nao.”

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia mfano huu:

teaching.description: KARAMU KUU
teaching.name: Luka 14:7-15:3

content: “Ikiwa mmoja wenu ana kondoo mia moja, naye akapoteza mmoja wao, je, hawaachi wale tisini na tisa nyikani na kwenda kumtafuta huyo aliyepotea mpaka ampate?

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Naye akishampata, humbeba mabegani mwake kwa furaha

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: na kwenda nyumbani. Kisha huwaita rafiki zake na majirani, na kuwaambia, ‘Furahini pamoja nami; nimempata kondoo wangu aliyepotea.’

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Nawaambieni, vivyo hivyo kutakuwa na furaha zaidi mbinguni kwa sababu ya mwenye dhambi mmoja atubuye, kuliko kwa wenye haki tisini na tisa ambao hawana haja ya kutubu.”

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: “Au ikiwa mwanamke ana sarafu za fedha kumi, naye akapoteza moja, je, hawashi taa na kufagia nyumba na kuitafuta kwa bidii mpaka aipate?

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Naye akiisha kuipata, huwaita rafiki zake na majirani na kuwaambia, ‘Furahini pamoja nami; nimeipata ile sarafu yangu ya fedha iliyopotea.’

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Vivyo hivyo, nawaambia, kuna furaha mbele ya malaika wa Mungu juu ya mwenye dhambi mmoja atubuye.”

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Yesu akaendelea kusema: “Kulikuwa na mtu mmoja aliyekuwa na wana wawili.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Yule mdogo akamwambia baba yake, ‘Baba, nipe urithi wangu.’ Hivyo akawagawia wanawe mali yake.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: “Baada ya muda mfupi, yule mdogo akakusanya vitu vyote alivyokuwa navyo, akaenda nchi ya mbali, na huko akaitapanya mali yake kwa maisha ya anasa.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Baada ya kutumia kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, kukawa na njaa kali katika nchi ile yote, naye akawa hana chochote.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Kwa hiyo akaenda akaajiriwa na mwenyeji mmoja wa nchi ile ambaye alimpeleka shambani kwake kulisha nguruwe.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Akatamani kujishibisha kwa maganda waliyokula wale nguruwe, wala hakuna mtu aliyempa chochote.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: “Lakini alipozingatia moyoni mwake, akasema, ‘Ni watumishi wangapi walioajiriwa na baba yangu ambao wana chakula cha kuwatosha na kusaza, bali mimi hapa nakufa kwa njaa!

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Nitaondoka na kurudi kwa baba yangu na kumwambia: Baba, nimetenda dhambi mbele za Mungu na mbele yako.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Sistahili tena kuitwa mwanao; nifanye kama mmoja wa watumishi wako.’

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content:
Basi akaondoka, akaenda kwa baba yake.
    “Lakini alipokuwa bado yuko mbali, baba yake akamwona, moyo wake ukajawa na huruma. Akamkimbilia mwanawe, akamkumbatia na kumbusu.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: “Yule mwana akamwambia baba yake, ‘Baba, nimekosa mbele za Mungu na mbele yako. Sistahili kuitwa mwanao tena.’

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: “Lakini baba yake akawaambia watumishi, ‘Leteni upesi joho lililo bora sana, tieni pete kidoleni mwake na viatu miguuni mwake.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Leteni ndama aliyenona, mkamchinje ili tuwe na karamu, tule na kufurahi.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Kwa maana huyu mwanangu alikuwa amekufa na sasa yu hai tena; alikuwa amepotea na sasa amepatikana!’ Nao wakaanza kufanya tafrija.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: “Wakati huo, yule mwana mkubwa alikuwa shambani. Alipokaribia nyumbani, akasikia sauti ya nyimbo na watu wakicheza.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Akamwita mmoja wa watumishi na kumuuliza, ‘Kuna nini?’

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Akamwambia, ‘Ndugu yako amekuja, naye baba yako amemchinjia ndama aliyenona kwa sababu mwanawe amerudi nyumbani akiwa salama na mzima.’

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: “Yule mwana mkubwa akakasirika, akakataa kuingia ndani. Basi baba yake akatoka nje na kumsihi.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Lakini yeye akamjibu baba yake, ‘Tazama! Miaka yote hii nimekutumikia na hata siku moja sijaacha kutii amri zako, lakini hujanipa hata mwana-mbuzi ili nifurahi na rafiki zangu.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Lakini huyu mwanao ambaye ametapanya mali yako kwa makahaba aliporudi nyumbani, wewe umemchinjia ndama aliyenona!’

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: “Baba yake akamjibu, ‘Mwanangu, umekuwa nami siku zote na vyote nilivyo navyo ni vyako.

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Lakini ilitubidi tufurahi na kushangilia kwa sababu huyu ndugu yako alikuwa amekufa na sasa yu hai; alikuwa amepotea naye amepatikana.’ ”

teaching.description: MFANO WA KONDOO ILIYOPOTEA
teaching.name: Luka 15:3-32

content: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Palikuwa na tajiri mmoja na msimamizi wake. Ilisemekana kwamba huyo msimamizi alikuwa anatumia vibaya mali ya tajiri yake.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Hivyo huyo tajiri akamwita na kumuuliza, ‘Ni mambo gani haya ninayoyasikia kukuhusu? Toa taarifa ya usimamizi wako, kwa sababu huwezi kuendelea kuwa msimamizi.’

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Yule msimamizi akawaza moyoni mwake, ‘Nitafanya nini sasa? Bwana wangu ananiondoa katika kazi yangu. Sina nguvu za kulima, nami ninaona aibu kuombaomba.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Najua nitakalofanya ili nikiachishwa kazi yangu hapa, watu wanikaribishe nyumbani kwao.’

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Kwa hiyo akawaita wadeni wote wa bwana wake, mmoja mmoja. Akamuuliza wa kwanza, ‘Deni lako kwa bwana wangu ni kiasi gani?’

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Yule bwana akamsifu yule msimamizi dhalimu kwa jinsi alivyotumia ujanja. Kwa maana watu wa dunia hii wana ujanja zaidi wanapojishughulisha na mambo ya dunia kuliko watu wa nuru.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Nawaambia, tumieni mali ya kidunia kujipatia marafiki, ili itakapokwisha, mkaribishwe katika makao ya milele.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Yeyote aliye mwaminifu katika mambo madogo, pia ni mwaminifu hata katika mambo makubwa, naye mtu ambaye si mwaminifu katika mambo madogo pia si mwaminifu katika mambo makubwa.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Ikiwa hamkuwa waaminifu katika mali ya kidunia, ni nani atakayewaaminia mali ya kweli?

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Nanyi kama hamkuwa waaminifu na mali ya mtu mwingine, ni nani atakayewapa iliyo yenu wenyewe?

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Hakuna mtumishi awezaye kuwatumikia mabwana wawili. Kwa kuwa atamchukia huyu na kumpenda yule mwingine, au atashikamana sana na huyu na kumdharau yule mwingine. Hamwezi kumtumikia Mungu pamoja na Mali.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Mafarisayo, waliokuwa wapenda fedha, waliyasikia hayo yote na wakamcheka kwa dharau.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi mnajionyesha kuwa wenye haki mbele za wanadamu, lakini Mungu anaijua mioyo yenu. Kwa maana vile vitu ambavyo wanadamu wanavithamini sana, kwa Mungu ni machukizo.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Sheria na Manabii vilihubiriwa mpaka kuja kwa Yohana Mbatizaji. Tangu wakati huo habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu zinahubiriwa, na kila mmoja hujiingiza kwa nguvu.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Lakini ni rahisi zaidi mbingu na dunia kupita kuliko hata herufi moja kuondoka katika Sheria.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Mtu yeyote amwachaye mkewe na kumwoa mwanamke mwingine anazini, naye mwanaume amwoaye mwanamke aliyetalikiwa anazini.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Palikuwa na mtu mmoja tajiri aliyevaa nguo za rangi ya zambarau na kitani safi, ambaye aliishi kwa anasa kila siku.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Hapo penye mlango wake aliishi maskini mmoja, jina lake Lazaro, mwenye vidonda mwili mzima.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Huyo Lazaro alitamani kujishibisha kwa makombo yaliyoanguka kutoka mezani kwa yule tajiri. Hata mbwa walikuwa wakija na kuramba vidonda vyake.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Wakati ukafika yule maskini akafa, nao malaika wakamchukua akae pamoja na Abrahamu. Yule tajiri naye akafa na akazikwa.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Kule kuzimu alipokuwa akiteseka, alitazama juu, akamwona Abrahamu kwa mbali, naye Lazaro alikuwa karibu yake.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Hivyo yule tajiri akamwita, ‘Baba Abrahamu, nihurumie na umtume Lazaro achovye ncha ya kidole chake ndani ya maji aupoze ulimi wangu, kwa sababu nina maumivu makuu kwenye moto huu.’

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Lakini Abrahamu akamjibu, ‘Mwanangu, kumbuka kwamba wakati wa uhai wako ulipata mambo mazuri, lakini Lazaro alipata mambo mabaya. Lakini sasa anafarijiwa hapa na wewe uko katika maumivu makuu.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Zaidi ya hayo, kati yetu na ninyi huko kumewekwa shimo kubwa, ili wale wanaotaka kutoka huku kuja huko wasiweze, wala mtu yeyote asiweze kuvuka kutoka huko kuja kwetu.’

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Akasema, ‘Basi, nakuomba, umtume Lazaro aende nyumbani kwa baba yangu,

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: maana ninao ndugu watano. Awaonye, ili wasije nao wakafika mahali hapa pa mateso.’

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Abrahamu akamjibu, ‘Ndugu zako wana Maandiko ya Mose na Manabii, wawasikilize hao.’

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Yule tajiri akasema, ‘Hapana, baba Abrahamu, lakini mtu kutoka kwa wafu akiwaendea, watatubu.’

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Abrahamu akamwambia, ‘Kama wasipowasikiliza Mose na Manabii, hawataweza kushawishika hata kama mtu akifufuka kutoka kwa wafu.’ ”

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Mambo yanayosababisha watu watende dhambi hayana budi kutukia. Lakini ole wake mtu yule anayeyasababisha.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Ingekuwa heri kama mtu huyo angefungiwa jiwe la kusagia shingoni na kutoswa baharini, kuliko kumsababisha mmojawapo wa hawa wadogo kutenda dhambi.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content:
Kwa hiyo, jilindeni.
    “Kama ndugu yako akikukosea mwonye, naye akitubu, msamehe.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Kama akikukosea mara saba kwa siku moja na mara saba kwa siku moja akaja kwako akisema, ‘Ninatubu,’ msamehe.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Mitume wake wakamwambia Bwana, “Tuongezee imani.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Bwana akawajibu, “Kama mkiwa na imani ndogo kama punje ya haradali, mngeweza kuuambia mti huu wa mkuyu, ‘Ngʼoka ukaote baharini,’ nao ungewatii.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Ikiwa mmoja wenu ana mtumishi anayelima shambani au anayechunga kondoo, je, mtumishi huyo arudipo atamwambia, ‘Karibu hapa keti ule chakula?’

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Je, badala yake, hatamwambia, ‘Niandalie chakula, nile, jifunge unitumikie ninapokula na kunywa; baadaye waweza kula na kunywa?’

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Je, huyo mtu atamshukuru mtumishi huyo kwa kutimiza yale aliyoamriwa?

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Vivyo hivyo nanyi mkiisha kufanya mliyoagizwa, semeni, ‘Sisi tu watumishi tusiostahili; tumefanya tu yale tuliyopaswa kufanya.’ ”

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Yesu alipokuwa njiani akienda Yerusalemu, alipitia mpakani mwa Samaria na Galilaya.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Alipokuwa akiingia kwenye kijiji kimoja, watu kumi waliokuwa na ukoma wakakutana naye. Wakasimama mbali,

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: wakapaza sauti, wakasema, “Yesu, Bwana, tuhurumie!”

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Alipowaona akawaambia, “Nendeni mkajionyeshe kwa makuhani.” Nao walipokuwa njiani wakienda, wakatakasika.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Mmoja wao alipoona kwamba amepona, akarudi kwa Yesu, akimsifu Mungu kwa sauti kuu.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Akajitupa miguuni mwa Yesu akamshukuru. Yeye alikuwa Msamaria.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Yesu akauliza, “Je, hawakutakaswa wote kumi? Wako wapi wale wengine tisa?

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Hakuna hata mmoja aliyeonekana kurudi ili kumshukuru Mungu isipokuwa huyu mgeni?”

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Yesu akamwambia, “Inuka na uende zako, imani yako imekuponya.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Yesu alipoulizwa na Mafarisayo Ufalme wa Mungu utakuja lini, yeye akawajibu, “Ufalme wa Mungu hauji kwa kuchunguza kwa bidii,

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: wala watu hawatasema, ‘Huu hapa,’ au ‘Ule kule,’ kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu umo ndani yenu.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Wakati utafika ambapo mtatamani kuiona moja ya siku ya Mwana wa Adamu, lakini hamtaiona.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Watu watawaambia, ‘Yule kule!’ Au, ‘Huyu hapa!’ Msiwakimbilie.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Kwa maana kama vile umeme wa radi umulikavyo katika anga kuanzia mwisho mmoja hadi mwingine, ndivyo atakavyokuwa Mwana wa Adamu katika siku yake.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Lakini kwanza itampasa kuteseka katika mambo mengi na kukataliwa na kizazi hiki.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Kama ilivyokuwa siku za Noa, ndivyo itakavyokuwa katika siku za Mwana wa Adamu.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakioa na kuolewa, mpaka siku ile Noa alipoingia katika safina. Ndipo gharika ikaja na kuwaangamiza wote.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Ndivyo ilivyokuwa katika siku za Loti: Watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakinunua na kuuza, wakilima na kujenga.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Lakini siku ile Loti alipoondoka Sodoma, ikanyesha mvua ya moto na kiberiti kutoka mbinguni ukawaangamiza wote.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: “Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa siku ile Mwana wa Adamu atakapofunuliwa.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Siku hiyo, mtu yeyote aliye juu ya dari ya nyumba yake, hata vitu vyake vikiwa ndani ya hiyo nyumba, asishuke kuvichukua. Vivyo hivyo mtu aliye shambani asirudi nyumbani kuchukua chochote.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Mkumbukeni mke wa Loti!

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Mtu yeyote anayejaribu kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, na yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake atayaokoa.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Nawaambia, usiku huo watu wawili watakuwa wamelala kitanda kimoja; naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Wanawake wawili watakuwa wanasaga nafaka pamoja; naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa. [

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Wanaume wawili watakuwa wanafanya kazi pamoja shambani; mmoja atachukuliwa na mwingine ataachwa.]”

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content:
Kisha wakamuuliza, “Haya yatatukia wapi Bwana?”
    Akawaambia, “Pale ulipo mzoga, huko ndiko tai watakapokusanyika.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWAJIBU MARAFIRAYO
teaching.name: Luka 16:1-17:37

content: Kisha Yesu akawapa wanafunzi wake mfano ili kuwaonyesha kuwa yawapasa kuomba pasipo kukata tamaa.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Akawaambia, “Katika mji mmoja alikuwepo hakimu ambaye hakumwogopa Mungu wala kumjali mtu.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Katika mji huo alikuwako mjane mmoja ambaye alikuwa akija kwake mara kwa mara akimwomba, ‘Tafadhali nipatie haki kati yangu na adui yangu.’

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: “Kwa muda mrefu yule hakimu alikataa. Lakini hatimaye akasema moyoni mwake, ‘Ijapokuwa simwogopi Mungu wala simjali mwanadamu,

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: lakini kwa kuwa huyu mjane ananisumbuasumbua, nitahakikisha amepata haki yake ili asiendelee kunichosha kwa kunijia mara kwa mara!’ ”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Bwana akasema, “Sikilizeni asemavyo huyu hakimu dhalimu.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Je, Mungu hatawatendea haki wateule wake wanaomlilia usiku na mchana? Je, atakawia kuwasaidia?

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Ninawaambia, atawapatia haki upesi. Lakini je, Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuja ataikuta imani duniani?”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yesu akatoa mfano huu kwa wale waliojiamini kuwa wao ni wenye haki na kuwadharau wengine:

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: “Watu wawili walikwenda Hekaluni kusali, mmoja wao alikuwa Farisayo na mwingine alikuwa mtoza ushuru.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yule Farisayo, akasimama, akasali hivi na kuomba kwake mwenyewe: ‘Mungu, nakushukuru kwa sababu mimi si kama watu wengine ambao ni wanyangʼanyi, wadhalimu, na wazinzi, wala kama huyu mtoza ushuru.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Mimi nafunga mara mbili kwa juma, na natoa sehemu ya kumi ya mapato yangu.’

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: “Lakini yule mtoza ushuru akasimama mbali, wala hakuthubutu hata kuinua uso wake kutazama mbinguni, bali alijipigapiga kifuani na kusema: ‘Mungu, nihurumie, mimi mwenye dhambi.’

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: “Nawaambia, huyu mtoza ushuru alirudi nyumbani akiwa amehesabiwa haki mbele za Mungu zaidi ya yule Farisayo. Kwa maana yeyote ajikwezaye atashushwa, na yeyote ajishushaye atakwezwa.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Pia, watu walikuwa wakimletea Yesu watoto wachanga ili awaguse. Wanafunzi wake walipoona hivyo, wakawakemea.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Lakini Yesu akawaita wale watoto waje kwake, akasema, “Waacheni watoto wadogo waje kwangu, wala msiwazuie, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu ni wa wale walio kama hawa.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Amin, nawaambia, mtu yeyote asiyeupokea Ufalme wa Mungu kama mtoto mdogo, hatauingia kamwe.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Mtawala mmoja akamuuliza Yesu, “Mwalimu mwema, nifanye nini ili niurithi uzima wa milele?”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yesu akamjibu, “Mbona unaniita mwema? Hakuna yeyote aliye mwema ila Mungu peke yake.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Unazijua amri: ‘Usizini, usiue, usiibe, usishuhudie uongo, waheshimu baba yako na mama yako.’ ”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Akajibu, “Amri hizi zote nimezishika tangu nikiwa mtoto.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yesu aliposikia haya, akamwambia, “Bado kuna jambo moja ulilopungukiwa. Nenda ukauze kila kitu ulicho nacho, uwape maskini, nawe utakuwa na hazina mbinguni. Kisha njoo, unifuate.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Aliposikia jambo hili, alisikitika sana kwa maana alikuwa mtu mwenye mali nyingi.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yesu akamtazama, akasema, “Tazama jinsi ilivyo vigumu kwa tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu!

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Hakika ni rahisi zaidi kwa ngamia kupita kwenye tundu la sindano kuliko mtu tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Wale waliosikia haya wakauliza, “Ni nani basi awezaye kuokoka?”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yesu akajibu, “Yasiyowezekana kwa wanadamu yanawezekana kwa Mungu.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Ndipo Petro akamjibu, “Tazama, tumeacha vyote tulivyokuwa navyo tukakufuata!”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yesu akajibu, “Amin, nawaambia, hakuna hata mtu aliyeacha nyumba yake, au mke, au ndugu, au wazazi au watoto kwa ajili ya Ufalme wa Mungu

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: ambaye hatapewa mara nyingi zaidi ya hivyo katika maisha haya, na hatimaye kupata uzima wa milele ujao.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yesu akawachukua wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili kando na kuwaambia, “Tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na kila kitu kilichoandikwa na manabii kumhusu Mwana wa Adamu kitatimizwa.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Kwa kuwa atatiwa mikononi mwa watu wasiomjua Mungu, nao watamdhihaki, watamtukana na kumtemea mate, watampiga mijeledi na kumuua.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Naye siku ya tatu atafufuka.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Wanafunzi wake hawakuelewa mambo haya, kwa kuwa maana yake ilikuwa imefichika kwao, nao hawakujua Yesu alikuwa anazungumzia nini.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yesu alipokuwa anakaribia Yeriko, kipofu mmoja alikuwa ameketi kando ya njia akiomba msaada.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Kipofu huyo aliposikia umati wa watu ukipita, akauliza, “Kuna nini?”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Wakamwambia, “Yesu wa Nazareti anapita.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Akapaza sauti, akasema, “Yesu, Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Wale waliokuwa wametangulia mbele wakamkemea, wakamwambia akae kimya. Lakini yeye akapaza sauti zaidi, “Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yesu akasimama, akawaamuru wamlete huyo mtu kwake. Alipokaribia, Yesu akamuuliza,

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content:
“Unataka nikufanyie nini?”
    Akajibu, “Bwana, nataka kuona.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yesu akamwambia, “Basi upate kuona. Imani yako imekuponya.”

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Akapata kuona saa ile ile, akamfuata Yesu, huku akimsifu Mungu. Watu wote walipoona mambo hayo, nao wakamsifu Mungu.

teaching.description: Yesu AWABARIKI WATOTO WADOGO
teaching.name: Luka 18

content: Yesu akaingia Yeriko, naye alikuwa anapita katikati ya huo mji.

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Tazama, palikuwa na mtu mmoja mkuu wa watoza ushuru naye alikuwa tajiri, jina lake Zakayo.

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Yeye alikuwa akijitahidi kumwona Yesu ni mtu wa namna gani. Lakini kutokana na umati mkubwa wa watu hakuweza kwa sababu alikuwa mfupi wa kimo.

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Kwa hiyo akatangulia mbio mbele ya umati wa watu akapanda juu ya mkuyu ili amwone Yesu, kwa sababu angeipitia njia ile.

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Yesu alipofika pale chini ya huo mkuyu, akatazama juu, akamwambia, “Zakayo, shuka upesi, kwa maana leo nitakuwa mgeni nyumbani kwako!”

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Hivyo Zakayo akashuka upesi, akamkaribisha Yesu nyumbani kwake kwa furaha kubwa.

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Watu wote walipoona hivyo, wakaanza kunungʼunika wakisema, “Amekwenda kuwa mgeni wa ‘mtu mwenye dhambi.’ ”

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Lakini Zakayo akasimama na kumwambia Bwana, “Tazama, Bwana! Sasa hivi nusu ya mali yangu ninawapa maskini, nami kama nimemdhulumu mtu yeyote kitu chochote, nitamrudishia mara nne ya hicho kiwango.”

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Leo, wokovu umeingia nyumbani humu, kwa sababu huyu naye ni mwana wa Abrahamu.

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu amekuja kutafuta na kuokoa kile kilichopotea.”

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Walipokuwa wanasikiliza haya, Yesu akaendelea kuwaambia mfano, kwa sababu alikuwa anakaribia Yerusalemu na watu walikuwa wakidhani ya kuwa Ufalme wa Mungu ulikuwa unakuja saa iyo hiyo.

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Hivyo akawaambia: “Mtu mmoja mwenye cheo kikubwa alisafiri kwenda nchi ya mbali ili akapokee madaraka ya kuwa mfalme, kisha arudi.

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: Hivyo akawaita kumi miongoni mwa watumishi wake, na akawapa kila mmoja fungu la fedha. Akawaambia, ‘Fanyeni biashara na fedha hizi mpaka nitakaporudi.’

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: “Lakini raiya wa nchi yake walimchukia wakapeleka ujumbe na kusema, ‘Hatutaki huyu mtu awe mfalme wetu.’

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: “Hata hivyo alirudi akiwa amekwisha kupokea mamlaka ya ufalme, akawaita wale watumishi wake aliokuwa amewaachia fedha, ili afahamu ni faida kiasi gani kila mmoja wao aliyopata kwa kufanya biashara.

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: “Wa kwanza akaja na kusema, ‘Bwana, kutokana na fedha uliyoniachia, nimepata faida mara kumi zaidi.’

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: “Yule bwana akamjibu, ‘Umefanya vizuri mtumishi mwema! Kwa sababu umekuwa mwaminifu katika wajibu mdogo sana, nakupa mamlaka juu ya miji kumi.’

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: “Wa pili naye akaja. Akasema, ‘Bwana, fedha yako imeleta faida mara tano zaidi.’

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19

content: “Bwana wake akajibu, ‘Nakupa mamlaka juu ya miji mitano.’

teaching.description: Yesu AINGIA YERIKO NA KATIKA NYUMBA YA ZAKAYO
teaching.name: Luka 19
