teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: na kuwatuma kwa Bwana ili kumuuliza, “Wewe ndiye yule aliyekuwa aje, au tumngojee mwingine?”

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Wale watu walipofika kwa Yesu wakamwambia, “Yohana Mbatizaji ametutuma tukuulize, ‘Wewe ndiye yule aliyekuwa aje, au tumngojee mwingine?’ ”

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Wakati huo huo, Yesu aliwaponya wengi waliokuwa na magonjwa, maradhi na pepo wachafu, na pia akawafungua vipofu wengi macho wakapata kuona.

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Hivyo akawajibu wale wajumbe, “Rudini mkamwambie Yohana yote mnayoyaona na kuyasikia: Vipofu wanapata kuona, viwete wanatembea, wenye ukoma wanatakaswa, viziwi wanasikia, wafu wanafufuliwa na maskini wanahubiriwa habari njema.

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Amebarikiwa mtu yule asiyechukizwa na mimi.”

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Wajumbe wa Yohana walipoondoka, Yesu akaanza kusema na makutano kuhusu Yohana Mbatizaji. Akawauliza, “Mlipokwenda kule nyikani, mlikwenda kuona nini? Je, ni unyasi ukipeperushwa na upepo?

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Kama sivyo, mlikwenda kuona nini basi? Mtu aliyevaa mavazi ya kifahari? La hasha, watu wanaovaa mavazi ya kifahari na kuishi maisha ya anasa wako katika majumba ya kifalme.

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Lakini mlikwenda kuona nini? Mlikwenda kumwona nabii? Naam, nawaambia, yeye ni zaidi ya nabii.

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content:
Huyu ndiye ambaye habari zake zimeandikwa:
  “ ‘Tazama, nitamtuma mjumbe wangu mbele yako,
    atakayetengeneza njia mbele yako.’

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Nawaambia, miongoni mwa wale waliozaliwa na wanawake, hakuna aliye mkuu kuliko Yohana. Lakini yeye aliye mdogo kabisa katika Ufalme wa Mungu ni mkuu kuliko Yohana.”

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: (Watu wote hata watoza ushuru waliposikia maneno ya Yesu, walikubali kwamba mpango wa Mungu ni haki, maana walikuwa wamebatizwa na Yohana.

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Lakini Mafarisayo na wataalamu wa sheria walikataa mpango wa Mungu kwao kwa kutokubali kubatizwa na Yohana.)

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Yesu akawauliza, “Niwafananishe na nini watu wa kizazi hiki? Wanafanana na nini?

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content:
Wao ni kama watoto waliokaa sokoni wakiitana wao kwa wao, wakisema:
  “ ‘Tuliwapigia filimbi,
    lakini hamkucheza;
  tuliwaimbia nyimbo za maombolezo,
    lakini hamkulia.’

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Kwa maana Yohana Mbatizaji alikuja, alikuwa hali mkate wala hanywi divai, nanyi mkasema, ‘Yeye ana pepo mchafu.’

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Mwana wa Adamu alikuja akila na kunywa, nanyi mnasema: ‘Tazameni huyu mlafi na mlevi, rafiki wa watoza ushuru na “wenye dhambi.” ’

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Nayo hekima huthibitishwa kuwa kweli na watoto wake wote.”

teaching.description: Yesu APONYA MTUMISHI WA AKIDA
teaching.name: Luka 7:1-35

content: Basi Farisayo mmoja alimwalika Yesu nyumbani kwake kwa chakula. Hivyo Yesu akaenda nyumbani mwa yule Farisayo na kukaa katika nafasi yake mezani.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Naye mwanamke mmoja kwenye ule mji, ambaye alikuwa mwenye dhambi, alipojua kwamba Yesu alikuwa akila chakula nyumbani kwa yule Farisayo, akaleta chupa ya marhamu yenye manukato.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yule mwanamke akasimama nyuma ya miguu ya Yesu akilia. Akailowanisha miguu yake kwa machozi yake, kisha akaifuta kwa nywele zake, akaibusu na kuimiminia manukato.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yule Farisayo aliyemwalika Yesu alipoona yanayotendeka, akawaza moyoni mwake, “Kama huyu mtu angekuwa nabii, angejua kwamba ni nani anayemgusa, na kwamba yeye ni mwanamke wa namna gani, na ya kuwa huyu mwanamke ni mwenye dhambi.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content:
Yesu akanena akamwambia, “Simoni, nina jambo la kukuambia.”
    Simoni akajibu, “Mwalimu, sema.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Wote wawili walipokuwa hawawezi kulipa, aliyafuta madeni yao wote wawili. Sasa ni yupi kati yao atakayempenda yule aliyewasamehe zaidi?”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content:
Simoni akajibu, “Nadhani ni yule aliyesamehewa deni kubwa zaidi.”
    Naye Yesu akamwambia, “Umehukumu kwa usahihi.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Kisha akamgeukia yule mwanamke, akamwambia Simoni, “Je, unamwona mwanamke huyu? Nilipoingia nyumbani mwako, hukunipa maji ya kunawa miguu yangu, lakini huyu ameninawisha miguu kwa machozi yake, na kunifuta kwa nywele zake.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Hukunisalimu kwa busu, lakini huyu mwanamke hajaacha kuibusu miguu yangu tangu nilipoingia.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Hukunipaka mafuta kichwani mwangu, lakini yeye ameipaka miguu yangu manukato.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Kwa hiyo, nakuambia, dhambi zake zilizokuwa nyingi zimesamehewa, kwani ameonyesha upendo mwingi. Lakini yule aliyesamehewa kidogo, hupenda kidogo.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Kisha akamwambia yule mwanamke, “Dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Lakini wale waliokuwa wameketi pamoja naye chakulani wakaanza kusemezana wao kwa wao, “Huyu ni nani ambaye hata anasamehe dhambi?”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yesu akamwambia yule mwanamke, “Imani yako imekuokoa; nenda kwa amani.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Baada ya haya Yesu alikwenda, akawa anazunguka katika miji na vijiji akihubiri habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu. Wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili walikuwa pamoja naye,

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: pia baadhi ya wanawake waliokuwa wametolewa pepo wachafu na kuponywa magonjwa. Miongoni mwao alikuwepo Maria Magdalene, aliyetolewa pepo wachafu saba;

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yoana mkewe Kuza, msimamizi wa nyumba ya watu wa nyumbani mwa Herode; Susana; na wengine wengi waliokuwa wakimhudumia kwa mali zao.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulipokuwa ukija kwa Yesu kutoka kila mji, akawaambia mfano huu:

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: “Mpanzi alitoka kwenda kupanda mbegu zake. Alipokuwa akitawanya mbegu, nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia; zikakanyagwa, nao ndege wa angani wakazila.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka penye miamba, nazo zilipoota, hiyo mimea ikakauka kwa kukosa unyevu.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Nazo mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye miiba, nayo ile miiba ikakua pamoja nazo, na kuisonga hiyo mimea.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content:
Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri. Zikaota na kuzaa mara mia moja zaidi ya mbegu alizopanda.”
    Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu akapaza sauti, akasema, “Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza maana ya mfano huo.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: “Maana ya mfano huu ni hii: Mbegu ni neno la Mungu.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Zile zilizoanguka kando ya njia ni wale ambao husikia neno, naye ibilisi anakuja na kuliondoa neno kutoka mioyoni mwao, ili wasije wakaamini na kuokoka.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye mwamba ni wale ambao hulipokea neno kwa furaha wanapolisikia, lakini hawana mizizi. Wanaamini kwa muda mfupi, lakini wakati wa kujaribiwa huiacha imani.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye miiba ni mfano wa wale wanaosikia, lakini wanapoendelea husongwa na masumbufu ya maisha haya, utajiri na anasa, nao hawakui.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Lakini zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye udongo mzuri ni mfano wa wale ambao hulisikia neno la Mungu na kulishika kwa moyo mnyofu wa utiifu, nao kwa kuvumilia kwingi huzaa matunda.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: “Hakuna mtu awashaye taa na kuificha ndani ya gudulia au kuiweka mvunguni mwa kitanda. Badala yake, huiweka juu ya kinara, ili wale waingiao ndani waone mwanga.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Kwa maana hakuna jambo lolote lililofichika ambalo halitafichuliwa, wala lolote lililositirika ambalo halitajulikana na kuwekwa wazi.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Kwa hiyo, kuweni waangalifu mnavyosikia. Kwa maana yeyote aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile anachodhani anacho atanyangʼanywa.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Wakati mmoja mama yake Yesu na ndugu zake walikuja kumwona, lakini hawakuweza kumfikia kwa sababu ya msongamano wa watu.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Mtu mmoja akamwambia, “Mama yako na ndugu zako wako nje wanataka kukuona.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yesu akamjibu, “Mama yangu na ndugu zangu ni wale wote wanaolisikia neno la Mungu na kulifanya.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Siku moja Yesu alipanda ndani ya mashua pamoja na wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Tuvukeni twende mpaka ngʼambo ya ziwa.” Nao wakaondoka.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Hivyo walipokuwa wakienda, akalala usingizi. Dhoruba kali ikatokea mle ziwani, hata mashua ikawa inajaa maji, nao walikuwa katika hatari kubwa.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content:
Wanafunzi wake wakamwendea na kumwamsha, wakisema, “Bwana, Bwana, tunaangamia!”
    Yeye akaamka, akaukemea ule upepo na yale mawimbi; dhoruba ikakoma, nako kukawa shwari.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content:
Akawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Imani yenu iko wapi?”
    Kwa woga na mshangao wakaulizana, “Huyu ni nani, ambaye anaamuru hata upepo na maji, navyo vikamtii?”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Basi wakafika katika nchi ya Wagerasi, ambayo iko upande wa pili wa ziwa kutoka Galilaya.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yesu aliposhuka kutoka mashua na kukanyaga ufuoni, alikutana na mtu mmoja wa mji ule aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu, naye kwa muda mrefu alikuwa havai nguo wala kuishi nyumbani, bali aliishi makaburini.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Alipomwona Yesu, alipiga kelele, akajitupa chini mbele yake na kusema kwa sauti kuu, “Una nini nami, Yesu, Mwana wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana? Nakuomba, usinitese!”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Wakati huo Yesu alikuwa amemwamuru yule pepo mchafu amtoke huyo mtu. Mara nyingi huyo pepo mchafu alimpagaa, na hata alipofungwa kwa minyororo mikono na miguu na kuwekwa chini ya ulinzi, alikata hiyo minyororo na kupelekwa na huyo pepo mchafu kwenda nyikani.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content:
Yesu akamuuliza, “Jina lako ni nani?”
    Akamjibu, “Legioni,” kwa kuwa alikuwa ameingiwa na pepo wachafu wengi mno.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi sana asiwaamuru kwenda katika Shimo.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Palikuwa na kundi kubwa la nguruwe hapo likilisha kando ya kilima. Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi Yesu awaruhusu wawaingie hao nguruwe, naye akawaruhusu.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Wale pepo wachafu walipomtoka yule mtu, wakawaingia wale nguruwe, nalo kundi lote likateremkia gengeni kwa kasi, likatumbukia ziwani na kuzama.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Wale watu waliokuwa wakichunga lile kundi la nguruwe walipoona yaliyotukia, wakakimbia, wakaeneza habari hizi mjini na mashambani.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Nao watu wakatoka kwenda kujionea wenyewe yaliyotukia. Walipofika hapo alipokuwa Yesu, wakamkuta yule mtu aliyetokwa na pepo wachafu amekaa karibu na Yesu, akiwa amevaa nguo na mwenye akili timamu! Wakaogopa.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Wale walioyaona mambo hayo wakawaeleza watu wengine jinsi yule mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo wachafu alivyoponywa.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Ndipo watu wote wa nchi ile ya Wagerasi wakamwomba Yesu aondoke kwao, kwa sababu walikuwa wamejawa na hofu. Basi akaingia katika mashua, akaondoka zake.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yule mtu aliyetokwa na pepo wachafu akamsihi Yesu afuatane naye, lakini Yesu akamuaga, akamwambia:

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: “Rudi nyumbani ukawaeleze mambo makuu Mungu aliyokutendea.” Kwa hiyo yule mtu akaenda, akatangaza katika mji wote mambo makuu ambayo Yesu alimtendea.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Basi Yesu aliporudi, umati mkubwa wa watu ukampokea kwa furaha, kwani walikuwa wakimngojea.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Kisha mtu mmoja, jina lake Yairo, aliyekuwa kiongozi wa sinagogi, akaja na kuanguka miguuni mwa Yesu, akimwomba afike nyumbani kwake,

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content:
kwa kuwa binti yake wa pekee, mwenye umri wa miaka kumi na miwili, alikuwa anakufa.
    Yesu alipokuwa akienda, umati wa watu ukamsonga sana.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Katika umati huo palikuwa na mwanamke mmoja aliyekuwa na tatizo la kutokwa damu kwa muda wa miaka kumi na miwili. Tena alikuwa amegharimia yote aliyokuwa nayo kwa ajili ya matibabu, wala hakuna yeyote aliyeweza kumponya.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Huyo mwanamke akaja kwa nyuma ya Yesu na kugusa upindo wa vazi lake. Mara kutokwa damu kwake kukakoma.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content:
Yesu akauliza, “Ni nani aliyenigusa?”
    Watu wote walipokana, Petro akasema, “Bwana, huu umati wa watu unakusonga na kukusukuma kila upande.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Lakini Yesu akasema, “Kuna mtu aliyenigusa, kwa maana nimetambua kuwa nguvu zimenitoka.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yule mwanamke alipofahamu ya kuwa hawezi kuendelea kujificha, alikuja akitetemeka, akaanguka miguuni mwa Yesu. Akaeleza mbele ya watu wote kwa nini alimgusa na jinsi alivyoponywa mara.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Basi Yesu akamwambia, “Binti, imani yako imekuponya. Nenda kwa amani.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yesu alipokuwa bado anasema, akaja mtumishi kutoka nyumbani kwa Yairo, yule kiongozi wa sinagogi, kumwambia, “Binti yako amekwisha kufa. Usiendelee kumsumbua Mwalimu.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yesu aliposikia jambo hili, akamwambia Yairo, “Usiogope. Amini tu, naye binti yako atapona.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Walipofika nyumbani kwa Yairo, hakumruhusu mtu yeyote aingie ndani naye isipokuwa Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, pamoja na baba na mama wa yule binti.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Wakati ule ule watu wote walikuwa wakilia na kuomboleza kwa ajili ya huyo binti. Yesu akawaambia, “Acheni kulia. Huyu binti hajafa, ila amelala.”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Wao wakamcheka kwa dharau, wakijua kuwa amekwisha kufa.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yesu akamshika yule binti mkono na kuita, “Binti, amka!”

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Roho yake ikamrudia, naye akainuka mara moja. Akaamuru apewe kitu cha kula.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Wazazi wake wakastaajabu sana, lakini Yesu akawakataza wasimwambie mtu yeyote juu ya yale yaliyotukia.

teaching.description: Yesu AENDA KULA KATIKA NYUMBA YA FARISAYO
teaching.name: Luka 7:36-8:56

content: Yesu kisha akawaita wale kumi na wawili pamoja, akawapa mamlaka na uwezo wa kutoa pepo wachafu wote na kuponya magonjwa yote,

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: kisha akawatuma waende wakahubiri Ufalme wa Mungu na kuponya wagonjwa.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Akawaagiza akisema, “Msichukue chochote safarini: sio fimbo, wala mkoba, wala mkate, wala fedha, hata msichukue kanzu ya ziada.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Katika nyumba yoyote mwingiayo, kaeni humo hadi mtakapoondoka katika mji huo.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Kama watu wasipowakaribisha, mnapoondoka katika mji wao, kungʼuteni mavumbi kutoka kwenye miguu yenu ili kuwa ushuhuda dhidi yao.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Hivyo wale wanafunzi wakaondoka wakaenda kutoka kijiji hadi kijiji, wakihubiri habari njema na kuponya wagonjwa kila mahali.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Basi Mfalme Herode, mtawala wa Galilaya, alisikia habari za yote yaliyotendeka. Naye akafadhaika, kwa kuwa baadhi ya watu walikuwa wakisema Yohana Mbatizaji amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Wengine wakasema Eliya amewatokea, na wengine wakasema kwamba mmoja wa manabii wa kale amefufuka.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Herode akasema, “Yohana nilimkata kichwa. Lakini ni nani huyu ambaye ninasikia mambo kama haya kumhusu?” Akatamani sana kumwona.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Mitume wake waliporudi, wakamweleza Yesu yote waliyofanya. Akawachukua, akaenda nao faraghani mpaka mji uitwao Bethsaida.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Lakini umati wa watu ukafahamu alikokwenda, ukamfuata. Akawakaribisha na kunena nao kuhusu Ufalme wa Mungu na kuwaponya wale wote waliokuwa wanahitaji uponyaji.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Ilipokaribia jioni, wale mitume kumi na wawili wakaenda kwa Yesu na kumwambia, “Waage makutano ili waende vijijini jirani na mashambani, ili wapate chakula na mahali pa kulala, kwa maana hapa tuko nyikani.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content:
Yesu akawajibu, “Ninyi wapeni chakula.”
    Nao wakajibu, “Hatuna zaidi ya mikate mitano na samaki wawili. Labda twende tukanunue chakula cha kuwatosha watu hawa wote.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Wanafunzi wakafanya hivyo, wakawaketisha wote.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yesu akaichukua ile mikate mitano na wale samaki wawili, akatazama mbinguni, akavibariki na kuvimega. Kisha akawapa wanafunzi ili wawagawie watu.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Wote wakala, wakashiba. Nao wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Wakati mmoja, Yesu alipokuwa akiomba faraghani, nao wanafunzi wake wakiwa pamoja naye, akawauliza, “Watu husema mimi ni nani?”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Wakamjibu, “Baadhi husema wewe ni Yohana Mbatizaji, wengine husema ni Eliya, na bado wengine husema kwamba ni mmoja wa manabii wa kale amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content:
Kisha akawauliza, “Je, ninyi mnasema mimi ni nani?”
    Petro akajibu, “Wewe ndiwe Kristo wa Mungu.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yesu akawakataza wasimwambie mtu yeyote jambo hilo.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yesu akasema, “Imempasa Mwana wa Adamu kupata mateso mengi na kukataliwa na wazee, viongozi wa makuhani, na walimu wa sheria, na itampasa auawe, lakini siku ya tatu kufufuliwa kutoka mauti.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Kisha akawaambia wote, “Mtu yeyote akitaka kunifuata, ni lazima ajikane mwenyewe, auchukue msalaba wake kila siku, anifuate.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Kwa maana yeyote anayetaka kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, lakini yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake kwa ajili yangu atayaokoa.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Je, itamfaidi nini mtu kuupata ulimwengu wote, lakini akapoteza au kuangamiza nafsi yake?

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Mtu yeyote akinionea aibu mimi na maneno yangu, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamwonea aibu atakapokuja katika utukufu wake na katika utukufu wa Baba, pamoja na malaika watakatifu.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Amin, nawaambia, wako baadhi ya watu waliosimama hapa ambao hawataonja mauti kabla ya kuuona Ufalme wa Mungu.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yapata siku nane baada ya Yesu kusema hayo, aliwachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, akaenda nao mlimani kuomba.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Alipokuwa akiomba, sura ya uso wake ikabadilika, nayo mavazi yake yakametameta kama mwanga wa umeme wa radi.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Ghafula wakawaona watu wawili, ndio Mose na Eliya, wakizungumza naye.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Walionekana katika utukufu wakizungumza na Yesu kuhusu kifo chake ambacho kingetokea huko Yerusalemu.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Petro na wenzake walikuwa wamelala usingizi mzito. Walipoamka, wakaona utukufu wa Yesu na wale watu wawili waliokuwa wamesimama pamoja naye.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Mose na Eliya walipokuwa wanaondoka, Petro akamwambia Yesu, “Bwana, ni vizuri tukae hapa! Tutajenga vibanda vitatu: kimoja chako, kingine cha Mose na kingine cha Eliya.” Lakini Petro alikuwa hajui asemacho.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Alipokuwa bado anazungumza, pakatokea wingu, likawafunika, nao wakaogopa walipoingia mle kwenye wingu.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Sauti ikatoka kwenye lile wingu ikisema, “Huyu ni Mwanangu mpendwa, niliyemchagua. Msikieni yeye.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Baada ya sauti hiyo kusema, walimkuta Yesu akiwa peke yake. Wale wanafunzi wakalihifadhi jambo hili, wala kwa wakati huo hawakumwambia mtu yeyote yale waliyokuwa wameyaona.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Kesho yake waliposhuka kutoka mlimani, alikutana na umati mkubwa wa watu.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Mtu mmoja katika ule umati wa watu akapaza sauti, akasema, “Mwalimu, naomba umwangalie mwanangu, kwani ndiye mtoto wangu wa pekee.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Mara kwa mara pepo mchafu humpagaa na kumfanya apige kelele, kisha humwangusha na kumtia kifafa hata akatokwa na povu kinywani. Huyo pepo mchafu anamtesa sana, na hamwachi ila mara chache.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Niliwaomba wanafunzi wako wamtoe huyo pepo mchafu, lakini hawakuweza.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yesu akawajibu, “Enyi kizazi kisichoamini na kilichopotoka! Nitakaa nanyi na kuwavumilia mpaka lini? Mlete mwanao hapa.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Hata yule mtoto alipokuwa akija, yule pepo mchafu akamwangusha, akamtia kifafa. Lakini Yesu akamkemea yule pepo mchafu amtoke, akamponya yule mtoto, na akamrudisha kwa baba yake.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content:
Watu wote wakastaajabia uweza mkuu wa Mungu.
    Wakati bado watu walikuwa wanastaajabia hayo yote aliyokuwa akiyafanya Yesu, yeye akawaambia wanafunzi wake:

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: “Sikilizeni kwa makini haya nitakayowaambia sasa: Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa watu.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Lakini wao hawakuelewa alimaanisha nini. Maana ya maneno hayo ilifichika kwao, hivyo hawakuyaelewa, nao wakaogopa kumuuliza maana yake.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Kukazuka mabishano miongoni mwa wanafunzi kuhusu ni nani miongoni mwao atakayekuwa mkuu kuliko wote.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Lakini Yesu akayatambua mawazo yao, naye akamchukua mtoto mdogo, akamsimamisha kando yake.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Kisha akawaambia, “Yeyote amkaribishaye mtoto huyu mdogo kwa Jina langu, anikaribisha mimi, na yeyote atakayenikaribisha mimi, atakuwa amemkaribisha yeye aliyenituma. Kwa maana yeye aliye mdogo miongoni mwenu, ndiye aliye mkuu kuliko wote.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yohana akasema, “Bwana, tumemwona mtu akitoa pepo wachafu kwa jina lako, nasi tukamzuia, kwa sababu yeye si mmoja wetu.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yesu akasema, “Msimzuie, kwa sababu yeyote ambaye si kinyume nanyi, yu upande wenu.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Wakati ulipokaribia wa yeye kuchukuliwa mbinguni, alikaza uso wake kwenda Yerusalemu.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Akatuma watu wamtangulie, nao wakaenda katika kijiji kimoja cha Samaria kumwandalia kila kitu;

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: lakini watu wa kijiji kile hawakumkaribisha kwa sababu alikuwa anakwenda zake Yerusalemu.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Wanafunzi wake, yaani Yakobo na Yohana, walipoona hayo, wakasema: “Bwana, unataka tuagize moto kutoka mbinguni ili uwaangamize?”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yesu akageuka na kuwakemea,

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: nao wakaenda kijiji kingine.

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Walipokuwa njiani wakienda, mtu mmoja akamwambia Yesu, “Nitakufuata kokote uendako.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yesu akamjibu, “Mbweha wana mapango, nao ndege wa angani wana viota, lakini Mwana wa Adamu hana mahali pa kulaza kichwa chake.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content:
Yesu akamwambia mtu mwingine, “Nifuate.”
    Mtu huyo akamjibu, “Bwana, niruhusu kwanza nikamzike baba yangu.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yesu akamwambia, “Waache wafu wawazike wafu wao, bali wewe nenda ukautangaze Ufalme wa Mungu.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Mtu mwingine akamwambia, “Bwana, nitakufuata lakini naomba kwanza nikawaage jamaa yangu.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24

content: Yesu akamwambia, “Mtu yeyote atiaye mkono wake kulima, kisha akatazama nyuma, hafai kwa Ufalme wa Mungu.”

teaching.description: Yesu ALISHA WATU ELFU TANO
teaching.name: Luka 9:1-10:24
